_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Hannibal Evans Lloyd (1771-1847): Prince Maximilian of Wied's Travels in the Interior of North America (1843; Thwaites's Early Western Travels reprint, 1905-06, 3 vols) and Iffland's The Nephews (1799). US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 30); Adam may veto. No uids minted. From archive.org (2026-10-23): Pückler-Muskau's Egypt under Mehemet Ali vol. II (1845), Raumer's England in 1835 (Philadelphia, 1836, with Sarah Austin) and England in 1841 (2 vols, 1842), Spix and Martius's Travels in Brazil vol. I (1824) and Orlich's Travels in India vol. I (1845).
